title: Towards Substantive Conceptions of Algorithmic Fairness: Normative Guidance from Equal Opportunity Doctrines
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on algorithmic fairness through the lens of political philosophy, specifically Equal Opportunity doctrines, with examples related to race, gender, socio-economic status, and criminal history.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The analysis is focused on developing a taxonomy of algorithmic fairness based on philosophical doctrines of Equal Opportunity and does not use religious affiliation as a dimension for its analysis.
